# Adam Podolak Portfolio

> Interactive portfolio for Adam Podolak, a content creator and video editor focused on editorial reels, short-form campaign cutdowns, creator portraits, photo direction, and post-production delivery.

## Canonical URL

https://adampodolak.com/

## Primary Topics

- Video editing
- Editorial reels
- Short-form social content
- Brand launch campaign assets
- Creator portrait direction
- Post-production workflows

## Portfolio Highlights

- Editorial Reel: pacing, punchy transitions, sound-led cuts, and platform-native storytelling.
- Launch Campaign Cutdowns: teaser, launch, proof, and recap assets for sustained distribution.
- Creator Portrait Set: natural light, practical locations, and thumbnail-first crops.
- Editing Table: color passes, select pulls, captions, and delivery packs for fast review cycles.
